document_summary: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 8 (§§98.0801-98.0806), which prohibits housing discrimination based on a tenant's source of income, including rental assistance and vouchers, in the City of San Diego.

rules.title: San Diego Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income
rules.requirement: Landlords may not refuse to enter into or renew a tenancy, terminate a tenancy, or apply income standards that ignore a tenant's entire source of income, including rental assistance and vouchers, based on source of income. Income standards must account for aggregate income of co-tenants and cosigners on the same basis as married persons.
rules.key_value: Ban on source-of-income discrimination (includes federal, state, local or nonprofit rental assistance and subsidies)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental-units and tenancies in the City of San Diego as defined in Municipal Code section 98.0720.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where the owner or a family member resides in the same residential building and shares a bathroom or kitchen facility with the tenant or prospective tenant (§98.0804). Acts necessary to comply with program requirements related to source of income are excepted.
rules.interaction: Defines source of income more broadly than the California FEHA definition; landlords keep the right to reject applicants for other lawful reasons consistent with federal, state and local law.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code §§ 98.0801-98.0806 (Ord. O-20986 N.S.)
